newsitem.title: CHILE: Chilean shares end soft ahead of Q2 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Chilean shares end soft ahead of Q2 earnings.

text.p: Chilean blue chips closed weaker in steady trade with the market undermined by profit-taking and speculation of poor company second quarter earnings, said dealers.

"Results forecasts are making people scared that Chilean ADRs could slide," said Ida Longeri, head of research at brokerage Larrain Vial. "Although the figures are already incorporated in prices, when earnings are published there will be a short-term reaction."
The selective index closed down 0.82 percent at 134.66 points.
The general index shed 0.46 percent to 5,814.77 points in turnover of 14.6 billion pesos.
While company second quarter operating earnings will be strong, non-operating results will be hurt by a monetary correction, said Longeri.
Electric utilities are expected to report poor operating figures as a result of this year's drought which slashed power output from hydro-electric generators, said traders.
The market is also anticipating poor earnings from Chile's two largest banks, Santander and Santiago, whose figures will reflect high merger costs, they said.
